whyAria.title: Why Aria Prop instead of ChatGPT or a traditional CRM?
whyAria.subtitle: Aria Prop isn't a generic chatbot or a passive contact list: it is a dedicated real estate sales assistant.
whyAria.card1Title: Connect Your Real Catalog (Zero Hallucinated Data)
whyAria.card1Desc: Unlike generic ChatGPT, Aria Prop answers using your agency's actual inventory (via property files, PDFs, or CRM integrations). It shows real prices, specs, and current details.
whyAria.card2Desc: Traditional CRMs only store contacts. Aria Prop holds real sales conversations, checks buyer budgets, and books tours on your calendar autonomously.
whyAria.card3Title: Native on Web & WhatsApp (No Extra Apps)
whyAria.card3Desc: Works seamlessly on your website and WhatsApp Business number. Your clients don't need to download any apps or register anywhere.

flowDemo.heading: See how Aria understands context, memory, and ambiguity
flowDemo.step1Title: Prospect writes via WhatsApp or Web
flowDemo.step1Desc: It's 11:15 PM. A buyer asks about a 3-room apartment in Palermo.
flowDemo.step1UserMsg: Hi! Saw the 3-room apartment in Palermo ($175k). Is it available? Would love to see it.
flowDemo.step2Title: Aria replies instantly with real CRM data
flowDemo.step2Desc: No delay waiting for tomorrow. Aria delivers exact spec sheet from Tokko/EasyBroker.
flowDemo.step2BotMsg: Hello! Yes, it is available (Ref EB-4092). Features 85m², terrace balcony, and garage. Would you like to schedule an in-person tour this week?
flowDemo.step3Title: Qualifies budget and books appointment on your calendar
flowDemo.step3Desc: Aria verifies buyer availability and reserves directly in your schedule.
flowDemo.step3UserMsg: Yes, Saturday at 11:00 AM works for me.
flowDemo.step3BotConfirm: Awesome, Mateo! Tour scheduled for Saturday at 11:00 AM. Confirmation sent.
flowDemo.step4Title: Wake up to confirmed appointments in the morning
flowDemo.step4Desc: Qualified lead appears in control panel with budget, property, and appointment time.
flowDemo.cStep1Title: User makes a vague or incomplete request
flowDemo.cStep1Desc: Instead of guessing or failing, Aria asks for precise clarification to narrow down the search.
flowDemo.cStep1User: Hi, I am looking for something near downtown, not too expensive.
flowDemo.cStep1Bot: Hello! I would love to help you search. To refine the options: Are you looking to rent or buy, and what max budget do you have in mind?
flowDemo.cStep2Title: User clarifies and adds a new requirement
flowDemo.cStep2Desc: Aria remembers Downtown area, $140k budget, and retains garage preference seamlessly.
flowDemo.cStep2User: Looking to buy, up to $140,000. But actually it should have a parking space.
flowDemo.cStep2Bot: Understood. Filtering Sale in Downtown up to $140,000 with Garage. Found 2 options: 1) 2-Bedroom Condo in Bombal ($125,000) and 2) 3-Bedroom Apartment on España Ave ($138,000), both with private garage.
flowDemo.cStep3Title: User asks to compare by raising the budget
flowDemo.cStep3Desc: Aria doesn't start over: keeps Sale + Downtown + Garage and expands to $160k with larger properties.
flowDemo.cStep3User: What if I raise my budget to $160,000, what larger options show up?
flowDemo.cStep3Bot: Keeping Sale with Garage in Downtown and raising the max limit to $160,000, we add the 3-Bedroom Penthouse ($155,000) with terrace balcony and valet parking. Would you like to schedule a visit?
flowDemo.cStep4Title: User picks a date and Aria coordinates appointment
flowDemo.cStep4Desc: Aria confirms booking on agent's calendar and generates automatic lead score.
flowDemo.cStep4User: Yes, Saturday at 11:30 AM works great for me.
flowDemo.cStep4BotConfirm: Awesome, Carlos! Visit scheduled for Saturday at 11:30 AM. Qualified Lead (Budget: $160k | Score: 96/100 🔥). WhatsApp reminder sent.
flowDemo.cStep5Title: Lead registered with full context in CRM
flowDemo.cStep5Desc: All conversation context, recorded preferences ($160k, garage, downtown) and appointment time ready in dashboard.
